t: You're looking at Inner Bark Out, a painting by Flo Brooks. Brooks is a painter based in Devon, and she made this work. The title plays on the idea of bark, the outer skin of a tree, turned inside out. I don't have further information about its subject or how it came to be here, so I'll keep this short. Take your time with the painting and notice the colours and textures, and what they suggest to you.
